archetype: ORGANIC & PERFORMANCE PRO HYBRID (WhatsApp Emerald + Modern SaaS Bento)

entry_surfaces./: split hero with emerald dark gradient card left, interactive live WhatsApp simulation widget right
entry_surfaces./login: branded split login with left emerald value prop panel and right clean white authentication card
entry_surfaces./register: branded split registration with step indicator left and simple owner onboarding form right
entry_surfaces./onboarding: guided 8-step progress bar card with celebratory milestone animations and simple business inputs
entry_surfaces./app: command center dashboard with AI live pulse status banner, 5 metric cards, quick action bento, and recent conversations
entry_surfaces./app/configuracao: multi-tab agent studio with completion checkmarks (Minha empresa, Personalidade, Produtos, Conhecimento, Atendimento, Vendas, Recuperação, Agendamento, WhatsApp, Integrações, Teste)
entry_surfaces./app/conversas: dual-pane messenger inbox with real-time status badges (Em atendimento, Aguardando cliente, Precisa de humano, Resolvido)
entry_surfaces./app/recuperacao: inactive client win-back campaign builder with smart triggers, message templates, and estimated ROI
entry_surfaces./app/whatsapp: QR code live pairing screen with step-by-step mobile guide and instant webhook connection indicator
entry_surfaces./app/testar: interactive WhatsApp sandbox playground with live prompt inspection, tool calls, and streaming responses
entry_surfaces./admin: superadmin overview with tenant matrix, AI token usage metrics, latency monitors, and audit stream

visual_enhancers.card_style: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
visual_enhancers.footer_attribution: Criado com excelência por Neri Infotech (https://neriinfotech.netlify.app)

accessibility.contrast_minimum: 4.5:1 on all body and muted text; 3.0:1 on large text and controls
accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case with role prefix (e.g., data-testid="nav-login-button", data-testid="onboarding-step-next", data-testid="chat-send-button", data-testid="whatsapp-status-badge")
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full focus-visible styling with ring-2 ring-emerald-500 ring-offset-2 on interactive nodes

instructions_to_main_agent.language: pt-BR (Português do Brasil) across all user-facing UI, alerts, and tooltips
instructions_to_main_agent.tone: Warm, accessible, jargon-free for non-technical small business owners (e.g. 'Ensine sua IA' instead of 'Knowledge Base', 'Conexão automática' instead of 'Webhook', 'Personalidade da IA' instead of 'System Prompt')
instructions_to_main_agent.branding_mandate: Prominently display footer credit 'Criado por Neri Infotech' with link to 'https://neriinfotech.netlify.app' in public pages and app footer
instructions_to_main_agent.status_indicators: Clear color-coded AI status: 🟢 Funcionando perfeitamente, ⚠️ Precisa de configuração, 🔴 Desconectado, ⚪ Em pausa
instructions_to_main_agent.empty_states: All views (empty catalog, no conversations yet, no knowledge uploaded) MUST feature friendly illustrations/icons, clear explanation in Portuguese, and a 1-click CTA to seed or create

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.design_purity: Avoid generic AI slop. Use rich emerald accents (#059669 / #10B981) paired with clean slate typography and crisp 1px borders.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous padding (p-6, p-8) on all container cards. Never crowd text against card borders.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.icons: Use lucide-react icons exclusively. Never use raw AI/robot emojis for system icons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid: Every button, input, tab, metric card, and modal action MUST have a data-testid attribute for automated end-to-end verification.
